title: Character Expansion Pack - Paladin, Gunslinger & Alchemist
description:
[h1]Character Expansion Pack[/h1]
Three new characters for Slay the Spire 2, built to be played together. One mod, so a co-op lobby only has to match a single gameplay-affecting dependency.

[h2]The Paladin[/h2]
[i]Sworn to a light that has not answered in a long time. Holds the line anyway.[/i]
Fights in armor that regrows. [b]Plating[/b] front-loads every combat and the cards turn that wall into Block or damage. [b]Seals[/b] are banked verdicts: each cast pays now and stacks a charge, and [b]Judge[/b] unleashes the whole bank at once, so the real decision is always bank or cash. Every healing card has two faces: a once-per-copy heal scaled by [b]Spirit[/b] that Exhausts, and a [b]Tithe[/b] face that fires whenever you discard it and cycles back forever. 86 cards, 8 relics, 3 potions.

[h2]The Gunslinger[/h2]
[i]A weathered shooter off an endless road. Loads the cylinder, counts what is coming, and decides whether this is a turn for cover or for everything at once.[/i]
Fights with a visible six-chamber [b]Cylinder[/b]. [b]Load[/b] Rounds into it, [b]Fire[/b] to spend them, and the hammer advances whether or not the chamber was loaded. Nine kinds of ammunition do nine different things on the way out; [b]Cycle[/b], [b]Spin[/b] and [b]Deadeye[/b] decide what comes up next and how hard it lands, or pull the trigger on an empty chamber and take the [b]Click[/b]. [b]Gadgets[/b], [b]Armor[/b] and Weak give you a second plan for the turns the gun is dry. 104 cards, 9 relics, 3 potions.

[h2]The Alchemist[/h2]
[i]Treats the Spire as a very large, very hostile experiment. Takes notes between fights.[/i]
Plays out of the potion belt. Cards [b]Brew[/b] [b]Volatile[/b] potions into your slots: free to drink, gone the instant combat ends, so the belt is a resource to spend, not hoard. [b]Distill[/b] the ones you won't drink straight into Energy, Block, Poison or [b]Potency[/b], or [b]Infuse[/b] damage into an Unstable Concoction that banks all fight until you uncork it. Brewing mid-swing litters your deck with Volatile Residue and jams slots with inert reagents, so managing your own byproducts is half the deck. 90 cards, 8 relics, 25 potions.

[h2]Playtest build[/h2]
v0.1.0, built against game v0.107.1. [b]Requires BaseLib 3.4.7 exactly[/b]; other versions are not supported. All three characters now have their own hand-built animated bodies. Some card and relic art is placeholder, and balance is in progress. Everyone in a co-op lobby must be on the same version.
changeNote: v0.1.0: new square Workshop thumbnail. No change to the mod itself.
